pieces.Text: A marut's fists strike with the power of a thunderstorm.  For any given slam attack, a marut can choose whether the attack uses lightning or thunder.  A lightning attack deals an additional 3d6 points of electricity damage, and the resulting flash blinds the target for 2d6 rounds (Fortitude DC
negates the blindness).  A thunder attack deals an additional 3d6 points of sonic damage, and the resulting thunderclap deafens the target for 2d6 rounds (Fortitude DC
(slam,3d6 electricity or sonic and blindness or deafness)
